description: This file implements Base64 encoding and decoding functions, including helper functions for lookup and character decoding, as well as functions to encode binary data to Base64 string and decode Base64 string to binary data.

methods.name: unsigned char decode_base64_char(unsigned char in,bool * error)
methods.description: Decodes a single Base64 character to its corresponding 6-bit value, setting an error flag if character is illegal.

methods.name: rtError rtBase64_encode(const void * in,const unsigned int in_size,unsigned char ** out,unsigned int * out_size)
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string, handling padding and memory allocation.

methods.name: rtError rtBase64_decode(const unsigned char * in,const unsigned int in_size,void ** out,unsigned int * out_size)
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into binary data, handling padding, memory allocation, and error checking.
